symbols.name: B_SafetyGate1
symbols.role: Monitors guard gate 1 for the FG_01 laser interlock.
symbols.signal: Binary presence sensor. Monitors a guard gate. Must be Active, with both gates at their extended limit, before the laser may fire.

symbols.name: B_SafetyGate2
symbols.role: Monitors guard gate 2 for the FG_01 laser interlock.
symbols.signal: Binary presence sensor. Monitors a guard gate. Must be Active, with both gates at their extended limit, before the laser may fire.

symbols.name: P_Camera
symbols.signal: Enable, then trigger; reads back Ready, Busy, ResultValid and ResultOK. The twin echoes the two control bits and hands over the datum; the verdict is synthesised in OC_SIM FB_Camera.

symbols.name: Y_Gate1
symbols.role: Guard gate 1. Must be closed before the FG_01 laser may fire.
symbols.signal: Extending CLOSES the gate, retracting OPENS it, and retracted is home - the opposite sense to a transport stopper. Both limits are read; the two gates are commanded together.

symbols.name: Y_Gate2
symbols.role: Guard gate 2. Must be closed before the FG_01 laser may fire.
symbols.signal: Extending CLOSES the gate, retracting OPENS it, and retracted is home - the opposite sense to a transport stopper. Both limits are read; the two gates are commanded together.

symbols.name: Y_Gripper
symbols.signal: Double solenoid with both limits read. EXTENDED clamps the payload for marking and reading; retracted releases.

symbols.name: Y_LaserMark
symbols.signal: One control bit out enables the laser module; held high for 1 s it applies the mark. NO status bits - the PLC gets no confirmation that it fired.

symbols.name: Y_Platform
symbols.signal: Double solenoid with both limits read. Service positioning of the laser head. Never actuated during the production cycle.

symbols.name: Y_ReaderWindow
symbols.signal: Double solenoid with both limits read. EXTENDED opens the window for the read; retracted shields the optics and is home.

symbols.name: P_Camera
symbols.signal: Enable, then trigger; reads back Ready, Busy, ResultValid and ResultOK. The twin echoes the two control bits and hands over the datum; the verdict is synthesised in OC_SIM FB_Camera.

symbols.name: B_Detect1
symbols.signal: Grip witness for arm 1. Active while gripper 1 actually holds the part.

symbols.name: B_Detect2
symbols.signal: Grip witness for arm 2. Active while gripper 2 actually holds the part.

symbols.name: Y_AxisR1
symbols.signal: Double solenoid with both limits read. Rotary. Retracted is 0 deg and the receiving orientation; extended is 180 deg and the placing one.

symbols.name: Y_AxisX1
symbols.signal: Double solenoid with both limits read. MAX is raised; arm 1 rises once and stays up for the whole cycle.

symbols.name: Y_AxisX2
symbols.signal: Double solenoid with both limits read. MAX is the transfer position, min is home over slot 1.

symbols.name: Y_AxisY1
symbols.signal: Double solenoid with both limits read. MAX is the transfer position, min is home over slot 2.

symbols.name: Y_AxisY2
symbols.signal: Double solenoid with both limits read. The axis factor is inverted, so MAX is LOWERED.

symbols.name: Y_Gripper1
symbols.signal: Double solenoid with both limits read. EXTENDED grips. The limit proves the jaws moved, NOT that they caught anything - only B_Detect1 says that.

symbols.name: Y_Gripper2
symbols.signal: Double solenoid with both limits read. EXTENDED grips. The limit proves the jaws moved, NOT that they caught anything - only B_Detect2 says that.

symbols.name: B_NIO
symbols.signal: A VERDICT, not a sensor reading. Active means the press bottomed with nothing correctly seated. Only meaningful at the bottom limit with the hold expired.

symbols.name: Y_AxisZ
symbols.signal: Double solenoid with both limits read. EXTENDED presses down onto the part; retracted is clear. A double solenoid so an abort leaves it where it is.

symbols.name: B_Detect
symbols.signal: Grip witness in the jaws. Active while this unit carries a cap. NOT the same question as B_Part.

symbols.name: B_Part
symbols.signal: Binary presence sensor. On the FEED: a cap has arrived at the pick position. Once the gripper lifts one away it reports the NEXT one.

symbols.name: P_Camera
symbols.signal: Enable, then trigger; reads back Ready, Busy, ResultValid and ResultOK. The twin echoes the two control bits and hands over the datum; the verdict is synthesised in OC_SIM FB_Camera.

symbols.name: Y_AxisR
symbols.signal: Double solenoid with both limits read. Rotary. Extended is the fitting orientation, retracted is home.

symbols.name: Y_AxisX
symbols.signal: Double solenoid with both limits read. MAX is over the pallet, min is over the cap feed.

symbols.name: Y_AxisZ1
symbols.signal: Double solenoid with both limits read. EXTENDED lowers the cap onto the part on the pallet side.

symbols.name: Y_AxisZ2
symbols.signal: Double solenoid with both limits read. EXTENDED lowers to the cap at the pick position on the feed side.

symbols.name: Y_CapsSource
symbols.signal: Two bool outputs from the PLC and no status bits - the bunker reports nothing back. MIL turns both on together for as long as it is enabled.

symbols.name: Y_CapsSourceStopper
symbols.signal: Double solenoid with both limits read. EXTENDED BLOCKS the feed path and the queue accumulates against it. The opposite sense to a transport stopper.

symbols.name: Y_Gripper
symbols.signal: Double solenoid with both limits read. EXTENDED grips the cap. The limit proves the jaws moved, NOT that they caught one - only B_Detect says that.

symbols.name: B_SafetyGate1
symbols.role: Monitors guard gate 1 for the FG_01 laser interlock.
symbols.signal: Binary presence sensor. Monitors a guard gate. Must be Active, with both gates at their extended limit, before the laser may fire.

symbols.name: B_SafetyGate2
symbols.role: Monitors guard gate 2 for the FG_01 laser interlock.
symbols.signal: Binary presence sensor. Monitors a guard gate. Must be Active, with both gates at their extended limit, before the laser may fire.

symbols.name: P_Camera
symbols.signal: Enable, then trigger; reads back Ready, Busy, ResultValid and ResultOK. The twin echoes the two control bits and hands over the datum; the verdict is synthesised in OC_SIM FB_Camera.

symbols.name: Y_Gate1
symbols.role: Guard gate 1. Must be closed before the FG_01 laser may fire.
symbols.signal: Extending CLOSES the gate, retracting OPENS it, and retracted is home - the opposite sense to a transport stopper. Both limits are read; the two gates are commanded together.

symbols.name: Y_Gate2
symbols.role: Guard gate 2. Must be closed before the FG_01 laser may fire.
symbols.signal: Extending CLOSES the gate, retracting OPENS it, and retracted is home - the opposite sense to a transport stopper. Both limits are read; the two gates are commanded together.

symbols.name: Y_Gripper
symbols.signal: Double solenoid with both limits read. EXTENDED clamps the payload for marking and reading; retracted releases.

symbols.name: Y_LaserMark
symbols.signal: One control bit out enables the laser module; held high for 1 s it applies the mark. NO status bits - the PLC gets no confirmation that it fired.

symbols.name: Y_Platform
symbols.signal: Double solenoid with both limits read. Service positioning of the laser head. Never actuated during the production cycle.

symbols.name: Y_ReaderWindow
symbols.signal: Double solenoid with both limits read. EXTENDED opens the window for the read; retracted shields the optics and is home.

symbols.name: P_Camera
symbols.signal: Enable, then trigger; reads back Ready, Busy, ResultValid and ResultOK. The twin echoes the two control bits and hands over the datum; the verdict is synthesised in OC_SIM FB_Camera.

symbols.name: B_Detect1
symbols.signal: Grip witness for arm 1. Active while gripper 1 actually holds the part.

symbols.name: B_Detect2
symbols.signal: Grip witness for arm 2. Active while gripper 2 actually holds the part.

symbols.name: Y_AxisR1
symbols.signal: Double solenoid with both limits read. Rotary. Retracted is 0 deg and the receiving orientation; extended is 180 deg and the placing one.

symbols.name: Y_AxisX1
symbols.signal: Double solenoid with both limits read. MAX is raised; arm 1 rises once and stays up for the whole cycle.

symbols.name: Y_AxisX2
symbols.signal: Double solenoid with both limits read. MAX is the transfer position, min is home over slot 1.

symbols.name: Y_AxisY1
symbols.signal: Double solenoid with both limits read. MAX is the transfer position, min is home over slot 2.

symbols.name: Y_AxisY2
symbols.signal: Double solenoid with both limits read. The axis factor is inverted, so MAX is LOWERED.

symbols.name: Y_Gripper1
symbols.signal: Double solenoid with both limits read. EXTENDED grips. The limit proves the jaws moved, NOT that they caught anything - only B_Detect1 says that.

symbols.name: Y_Gripper2
symbols.signal: Double solenoid with both limits read. EXTENDED grips. The limit proves the jaws moved, NOT that they caught anything - only B_Detect2 says that.

symbols.name: B_NIO
symbols.signal: A VERDICT, not a sensor reading. Active means the press bottomed with nothing correctly seated. Only meaningful at the bottom limit with the hold expired.

symbols.name: Y_AxisZ
symbols.signal: Double solenoid with both limits read. EXTENDED presses down onto the part; retracted is clear. A double solenoid so an abort leaves it where it is.

symbols.name: B_Detect
symbols.signal: Grip witness in the jaws. Active while this unit carries a cap. NOT the same question as B_Part.

symbols.name: B_Part
symbols.signal: Binary presence sensor. On the FEED: a cap has arrived at the pick position. Once the gripper lifts one away it reports the NEXT one.

symbols.name: P_Camera
symbols.signal: Enable, then trigger; reads back Ready, Busy, ResultValid and ResultOK. The twin echoes the two control bits and hands over the datum; the verdict is synthesised in OC_SIM FB_Camera.

symbols.name: Y_AxisR
symbols.signal: Double solenoid with both limits read. Rotary. Extended is the fitting orientation, retracted is home.

symbols.name: Y_AxisX
symbols.signal: Double solenoid with both limits read. MAX is over the pallet, min is over the cap feed.

symbols.name: Y_AxisZ1
symbols.signal: Double solenoid with both limits read. EXTENDED lowers the cap onto the part on the pallet side.

symbols.name: Y_AxisZ2
symbols.signal: Double solenoid with both limits read. EXTENDED lowers to the cap at the pick position on the feed side.

symbols.name: Y_CapsSource
symbols.signal: Two bool outputs from the PLC and no status bits - the bunker reports nothing back. MIL turns both on together for as long as it is enabled.

symbols.name: Y_CapsSourceStopper
symbols.signal: Double solenoid with both limits read. EXTENDED BLOCKS the feed path and the queue accumulates against it. The opposite sense to a transport stopper.

symbols.name: Y_Gripper
symbols.signal: Double solenoid with both limits read. EXTENDED grips the cap. The limit proves the jaws moved, NOT that they caught one - only B_Detect says that.
